text:
Maya Ramos: Quick sync — SI onboarding retainer + HW/cloud kit handoff. We need to align training cadence, certification gates, and who signs off on lab kit costs. Goal: run first cohort by May 12.
Devon Lee: +1. Can we lock curriculum by Apr 18? I want labs and marketplace listing steps in the playbook.
Priya Nair: I can own curriculum. Need confirmation on lab env (GCP vs AWS sandbox) and access for partner engineers.
Carlos Mendez: For the HW partners, we'll need 8 dev kits shipped week of Apr 22. Who's approving shipping budget?
Maya Ramos: @Sasha Kim — can you confirm if we can use the existing SI retainer funds for kit shipping?
Sasha Kim: Checking finance. Looks like we have a small retainer pool; can cover up to $4k. We'll need a PO for anything beyond that.
Devon Lee: Noted. We'll prioritize remote-first labs; ship kits only to enterprise SI picks.
Priya Nair: Training cadence proposal: 3 x 90m live workshops (arch + ops + hands-on), then 2-week self-paced lab with mentor hours. Certification = pass 2 evals + demo.
Carlos Mendez: Agree. Suggested certification badges: "Redwood SI - Fundamentals" and "Redwood SI - Ops". Badges tied to Marketplace listing eligibility.
Maya Ramos: Love that. Action items: Priya drafts syllabus by Apr 11, Devon drafts playbook marketplace steps by Apr 15, Ops to provision sandbox by Apr 16.
Devon Lee: I'll add a checklist in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partnerships/pages/si-onboard-sprint
Priya Nair: Lab workspace details: workspace url + credentials will be posted to private partner channel. Example env: 
```
S3 bucket: s3://redwood-si-labs/devon-2026
K8s namespace: si-onboard-2026
```
Carlos Mendez: @deploy-bot can you spin a small cluster for the hands-on labs? 3 nodes, 2 CPU, 16GB each.
deploy-bot: Request received — cluster ci-si-197 is queued, ETA ~45m. :robot_face:
Sasha Kim: I'll confirm retainer coverage and send PO template by EOD tomorrow.
Maya Ramos: Great. One more: joint announcement cadence? We should time marketplace listing + first certified SI cohort. Target announcement window: May 20-27.
Devon Lee: Sounds good. I'll reach out to Marketing to draft a short partner story.
Priya Nair: Will add eval rubrics and scoring to the playbook. Prefer pass threshold 80%.
Carlos Mendez: Shipping list: send me partner names and addresses by Apr 14.
Maya Ramos: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a final PRD + calendar invites. :thumbsup:
